notes.title: Update 1.05 is AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285959/c06d41e0eb30b9962c62df519c790ec1ca4869c6.jpg

Hello everyone,

after being quit for some time, we are back with another update. We were completely focused on the update as our goal is still to improve the game, deliver on our promises and listen to your feedback. 

Changelog 1.05

 Debug string on skill fixed
 Infinite loading screen fixed
 Doom grenade skill fixed
 Lock on fixed
 M2_Cemetery enemies spawn on user’s sight fixed
 Gallery fixed
 Watchable fixed
 Low HP indicator displayed during the cutscenes fixed
 Cutscene on a bridge fixed
 Sawyer’s movement fixed
 Desmond’s hair fixed
 Embry’s cutscene fixed
 Damage done by Sawyer during the reload of checkpoint fixed
 Several achievements fixed
 Several minor gameplay issues fixed

notes.title: Update 1.03 is NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285959/13f287c7ba3be447235dcf1921282d3236caa2a7.jpg

Hello Destroyers (and Saviors),

the gates of hell opened once again and released another important update! Here is what it brings.

Changelog: 1.03

 Visualisation of remaining ‘last chances’ added
 Blend between heavy and light attacks fixed
 Lock on target added - you can now use ’R3’ on gamepad or ‘X’ on keyboard to lock Desmond on an enemy
 Several minor fixes in cutscenes
 Desmond sliding along the walls fixed
 Generic NPC overlapping fix 
 Jumping over an obstacle in a restaurant before the fight fixed
 Jumping over an obstacle on cemetery fixed
 The player now cannot dash through the closing gate in Industrial
 Barrier disappeared after reloading a checkpoint at Motel (fixed)
 Replaying a chapter should no longer disable the skills
 Chapters are enabled in main menu - you can replay any finished chapter

notes.title: Update 1.02 is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285959/35c3c07997bca080ada11af6ce9a553e30083a54.png

Hello everyone,

Sorry for staying silent these past two weeks. We were working on a patch to fix many issues reported by you guys as well as improving the game.

It's great time to get back to hell and warm yourself a bit in this cold weather. Rest assured that we certainly don't end with this patch and we will keep on working on the game, so please if you have any feedback or problems let us know :)

Changelog 1.02
 

 V-sync added
 Navigation of gallery fixed
 VoiceOver of Cutscene with Belial fixed
 Walking on spline in Jerusalem fixed
 Several missing VoiceOvers added
 Fixed an issue with multiple play of the same VoiceOver on Volcano level
 Several missing subtitles added
 Lighting in Lucifer’s court fixed
 Breaklines of text fixed
 Improved performance
 Camera on Jerusalem fixed
 Skeletal mesh of watchables fixed
 Shockwave skill fixed
 Credits music added
 Void skills selling fixed
 Unlocking void skill bug fixed
 Visible game version fixed
 Culling volume fixed
 Watchable in Dragan’s club fixed
 Hell Marshes cutscene fixed
 Skill tutorial on cemetery fixed

notes.title: First update is now out - 1.01!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285959/7ae3cba773faa5f0391b2757f6eca5197e15a35c.png

Hello everyone,

we just released our first update. It containes fixes based on what we have discovered and was reported to us by you guys. This is first of many updates. Expect more coming soon. They will not only fix bugs but also improve the game itself. Enough talking let's get to the changelog!

Changelog 1.01:

 Fixed a crash in main menu which is related to Unreal Engine issue - please make sure you have latest driver update.
 Fixed missing voice over in Belial cutscene.
 Fixed missing voices in visions - Jerusalem sewers.
 Removed chapter tab - it will be added in future patch.
 Fixed picking up second void skill on the level.
 Random crashes fixed.
 Fixed a lot of small bugs which were reported
